plans.idea: Editorial left-aligned column: a tall, generous text block fills the upper three-quarters so the headline and the three numbered steps set large, then a half-width pill CTA sits on the same left edge directly under the steps, with legal pinned to the foot.

Centred symmetrical story: the copy stack uses the full content width on a central axis, a wide centred pill CTA closes the stack, and the legal sits as a narrow centred footer, so the tall format reads cleanly top to bottom.

Thumb-zone story: the text runs edge to edge across most of the height so the steps get maximum size, and a full-width CTA bar anchors the bottom of the screen, with the legal tucked under it as the last line.
